native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'btn1': 'pressed', 'pot1': 'moved to max', 'pot2': 'at default', 'pot3': 'at default', 'servo1': 'position mapped to pot1'}, 'description': 'After initialization, button 1 is pressed to enable potentiometer 1. Potentiometer 1 is moved to its maximum position. The servo position should be mapped to the value of potentiometer 1.'}

test2: {'time': 1.0, 'state': {'btn2': 'pressed', 'pot1': 'at max', 'pot2': 'at default', 'pot3': 'at default', 'servo1': 'position unchanged'}, 'description': 'Button 2 is pressed to enable potentiometer 2. Potentiometer 1 remains at max, but servo position should not change because potentiometer 2 is now active and at default.'}

test3: {'time': 1.5, 'state': {'btn2': 'active', 'pot1': 'at max', 'pot2': 'moved to max', 'pot3': 'at default', 'servo1': 'position mapped to pot2'}, 'description': 'With button 2 active, potentiometer 2 is moved to its maximum position. The servo position should now be mapped to the value of potentiometer 2.'}

test4: {'time': 2.0, 'state': {'btn3': 'pressed', 'pot1': 'at max', 'pot2': 'at max', 'pot3': 'at default', 'servo1': 'position unchanged'}, 'description': 'Button 3 is pressed to enable potentiometer 3. Potentiometers 1 and 2 remain at max, but servo position should not change because potentiometer 3 is now active and at default.'}

test5: {'time': 2.5, 'state': {'btn3': 'active', 'pot1': 'at max', 'pot2': 'at max', 'pot3': 'moved to max', 'servo1': 'position mapped to pot3'}, 'description': 'With button 3 active, potentiometer 3 is moved to its maximum position. The servo position should now be mapped to the value of potentiometer 3.'}
